name: HAKO Raizes Vivas

origin.note: Original creature and mechanic: a root/tentacle segment that regrows two copies of itself when killed by anything except fire, spawned around a destructible core that stops all regrowth once destroyed. Inspired by the Hydra myth (public domain) and general genre conventions (stalker presence, escalating audio/visual cues) from horror media the user enjoys - no character designs, names, models, or code copied from any of it.

audio_asset.source: reuses "Jumpscare Scream" by Breviceps, Freesound.org, CC0 - see hako-corta-arvore-paroida catalog entry

visual_assets.geometry: hand-written blocky placeholder geometry (cuboid bones only), not final art
visual_assets.textures: procedurally generated placeholder textures (rp/textures/entity/*.png), not final art
visual_assets.note: Functional but not visually polished. Intended to be reskinned with real art later.

gameplay_contracts: Summon hako:raiz_nucleo spawns a core plus an initial ring of 4 hako:raiz_segmento entities.
Killing a segment by any non-fire cause spawns 2 new segments near its death location, tagged to the same core.
Killing a segment by fire/lava/campfire ends it permanently - no regrowth.
If the core tied to a segment is already dead when that segment dies, no regrowth occurs even for a non-fire kill.
Destroying the core plays a distinct 'core defeated' cue and permanently stops all further regrowth for that cluster.
Each regrowth event triggers camera shake, a glitch actionbar title, and the glitch scream sound for nearby players.
